events.evidence: A suicide car bomber kills at least 18 and injuries at least 25, mostly Iraqi Police, in an ambush in the northern Iraqi city of Kirkuk
high levels of benzene are released into the Songhua River in northeastern China
Italian Army could leave Iraq by the end of 2006

label.note: Kirkuk bombing and China benzene spill raise local risk; Italy's Iraq exit signal and Liberia election offer offsets.
